title: What Happens to a Paver Driveway During Extreme Freeze–Thaw Cycles?
intro: Chicago winters are legendary for their dramatic swings, subjecting our homes and landscapes to relentless challenges. From the biting winds off Lake Michigan to the rapid temperature drops and sudden thaws, our climate presents unique hurdles for outdoor surfaces. For homeowners considering a new driveway, a common concern arises: what truly happens to a paver driveway during these extreme freeze–thaw cycles? It's a valid question, rooted in the costly lessons learned from cracked concrete and crumbling asphalt. However, modern paver driveways, when properly installed and maintained, are engineered to not just survive but thrive in environments like ours. This expert guide will demystify the science behind freeze–thaw damage and reveal why interlocking concrete pavers are an exceptionally resilient choice for your Chicago home, offering lasting beauty and unparalleled durability.
